proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL laśuna section 1 gives Prakrit lasuṇa/lasaṇa/lhasuṇa, Gujarati lasaṇ, Marathi lasūṇ/lasaṇ, Hindi lasun/lahsun/lahsan and Assamese lahan. These document the sibilant and h-medial l-initial garlic family. Survey vowel variation, ś/ç notation and nasal place are preserved; ordinary endings are grouped, but m-final and n-initial forms are excluded. Local IA transmission remains unresolved, as also reflected by the article questioning Hindi influence on Punjabi. Exact response: lesuṇ.
